Crosses private land: you need the landowner's OK.
Narrow trail: may be hiking-only. Check for signs.
{note} allows ATVs on its roads (by-law). Ride the shoulder, 20 km/h where posted 50 or less, 50 km/h max.

Rail trail / multi-use trail: usually needs a club pass ({note}).
Trail not on Crown land and not in any club system: probably private. Ask first.

Bancroft.conditions: By-law 01-2004 permitted ATVs on all roads under Town jurisdiction, at 20 km/h where posted 50 or less and 50 km/h where posted over 50. Updated by 49-2015 and 43-2020; a later amendment (date unknown) added off-road motorcycles and ETVs. Hwy 28/62 inside town limits are provincial (see Schedule A: Hwy 62 south of Bay Lake Rd is prohibited). Bancroft is a town, so the O. Reg. 8/03 default does not apply.
Bancroft.bylaw: 01-2004, updated 49-2015 and 43-2020 (texts of the updates not read)

Hastings Highlands.conditions: No ORV road by-law found. The municipality is listed in O. Reg. 8/03, so ORVs are allowed on municipal roads by default since Jan 1, 2021 unless a prohibiting by-law exists (none found). Includes Maynooth, Lake St. Peter, Birds Creek.

Faraday.conditions: By-law 25-2015 regulates ORVs on municipal highways; the operative road list was not seen. Listed in 8/03 (default allowed). Unopened road allowances need written council approval (By-law 21-2024).

Wollaston.conditions: By-law 2021-0005 (cited as 05-2021) regulates ORVs in the township. A trail access pass (OFATV, EOTA, KATVA or HATVA) is required on the township-owned Wollaston Rail Trail, whose lease to Coe Hill Riders runs to Feb 2029. Road provisions not seen. Listed in 8/03 (default allowed). Includes Coe Hill. Nellie Lunn Park: no motorized vehicles.

Limerick.conditions: No ORV road by-law found. Council has agreements with the Coe Hill ATV Club (By-law 2025-04 agreement) and a 2021 'By-law for Trails' was in progress. 8/03 status not verified (probably listed, as a township).

Tudor and Cashel.conditions: By-law 2015-22 allows ATVs, ORVs and UTVs on municipal highways, subject to O. Reg. 316/03 equipment, permit, insurance, licence and helmet rules. Speed 20 km/h where posted 50 or less, 50 km/h where over 50. Later amendments unknown. Listed in 8/03.

Carlow/Mayo.conditions: The township lists an 'Off-Road Vehicles' by-law under its Roads category; contents and number not seen. 8/03 status not verified.

Marmora and Lake.conditions: ATV By-law 2004-10, amended by 2015-31; contents not seen. Crowe Valley CA barricaded the EOTA trail ramp into Callaghan's Rapids CA (2022). 'Municipality' status means it may not be in 8/03.

Madoc (Township).conditions: Nothing found. Probably listed in 8/03 as a township, but not verified.

Centre Hastings.conditions: No ORV by-law among the commonly requested by-laws. The municipal trail network (22 km) is promoted for ATVs. Includes Madoc village (Hwy 62/7).

Tweed.conditions: By-law 2017-16 regulates ORVs on municipal highways; routes and hours not seen.

Highlands East.conditions: By-law 2020-67: municipal roads open to ORVs under O. Reg. 316/03 and the ORV Act, with sections 7-15 (equipment) and 16-24 (operation) applying. Speed 20/50 km/h. Off-road motorcycles and Argo-type vehicles were added in 2020. A newer version may exist (one listing dated Jan 2024 is marked 'pending'). Includes Wilberforce, Gooderham, Cardiff, Tory Hill.

Dysart et al.conditions: No ORV road by-law found in search. A 2019 article describes Haliburton County municipalities as permitting ORVs on roads by by-law. Haliburton County Rail Trail is for HATVA/KATVA permit holders only, May 1-Nov 30.

Minden Hills.conditions: No ORV by-law on the township's by-law lists. The township funded a HATVA trail link into Minden. Probably listed in 8/03 (township), so the default would allow. Not verified.

Algonquin Highlands.conditions: By-law 2020-73: ATVs, ROVs, MOHUVs, wheeled ETVs and off-road motorcycles allowed on all municipal roads (the title refers to the shoulder). Tracked ETVs not allowed. Speed 20/50 km/h. Listed in 8/03. Hwy 60 in this township (Algonquin Park corridor) is Schedule A.

Madawaska Valley.conditions: No ORV road by-law found. An MOU and land use agreement with the Renfrew County ATV Club cover the municipally owned rail trail (former railway, open to ATVs). County of Renfrew roads are covered by County By-law 91-24. Includes Barry's Bay, Combermere.

South Algonquin.conditions: By-law 2023-760 regulates ATVs, ETVs and off-road motorcycles on municipal highways under O. Reg. 316/03; road schedule not seen. A township newsletter advises not riding roads posted over 50 km/h. By-law 2023-777 bans ATVs on sidewalks, parks and township property without CAO consent. Includes Whitney, Madawaska.

Killaloe, Hagarty and Richards.conditions: Nothing found. Renfrew County roads: see County By-law 91-24.

Bonnechere Valley.conditions: By-law 2020-049 regulates ATVs on municipal highways; roads and hours not seen. The ATV club has a railbed agreement. Listed in 8/03. Includes Eganville.

Brudenell, Lyndoch and Raglan.conditions: Nothing found (only By-law 2023-04 on road service levels).

Greater Madawaska.conditions: By-law 71-2020 regulates ORVs on municipal roads (citing s.4.1 of 316/03); road list not seen. Includes Calabogie, Griffith.

Addington Highlands.conditions: 2004 by-law (reported in Frontenac News; number not found) allowed ATVs on township roads and road portions listed in a schedule, tied to signage of seasonally maintained roads. Current version unknown. Listed in 8/03, so the default may allow more. Lennox & Addington County roads are covered by County By-laws 3316/15 and 3326/16 (certain county roads). Includes Denbigh, Cloyne, Flinton, Northbrook.

North Frontenac.conditions: 2005 by-law: 4-wheeled ATVs on township roads or portions listed in a schedule, 6:00 a.m. to 11:00 p.m. The township sold road and trail permits around 2008-09. A 2005 article said ATVs could then ride all roads in Frontenac County. A 2022 review of recreational vehicles may have changed this. Current status unknown.

Central Frontenac.conditions: 2006 by-law: licensed, insured, single-seat 4-wheel ATVs on all municipal roads. Current version unknown (may since include more vehicle types). The K&P Trail is a Frontenac County trail (By-law 2022-0033).

Havelock-Belmont-Methuen.conditions: ATV access to township roadways is prohibited Dec 1 - Mar 31, enforced by AMP By-law 2024-024. Otherwise riders are welcome on township roads following township by-laws and the HTA. Banned year-round on sidewalks, driveways, private land, unopened road allowances, Mathison Conservation Area and municipal parks. Peterborough County roads in HBM (e.g. parts of CR 6, CR 30) follow the County schedule.
Havelock-Belmont-Methuen.bylaw: AMP By-law 2024-024 (seasonal prohibition); underlying ORV by-law number not found

North Kawartha.conditions: ATV By-law 2021-0026 with Schedule A road map allows ATVs on township roads; it rescinds 2017-109. A later 'ORV by-law and repeal ATV by-law' document exists (date and number not seen). Peterborough County roads in North Kawartha are NOT open (no county authorization there). Hwy 28 north of CR 504 is Schedule A. Includes Apsley.
North Kawartha.bylaw: 2021-0026 (possibly superseded by a newer ORV by-law)

Trent Lakes.conditions: The municipality has an Off Road Vehicle by-law page (contents not read). A 2019 club article says Trent Lakes permits ORVs on roads by by-law. The Peterborough County schedule permits listed segments of CR 36, CR 37, CR 503 and CR 507 in Trent Lakes.

City of Kawartha Lakes.conditions: ATVs and side-by-sides only on roads the City has designated (yellow ATV-symbol signs). No ATVs on any Lindsay streets. Dirt bikes not permitted on any City road. Designated routes come from the task-force pilot (2021-2024), now approved. City, so no 8/03 default.

Admaston/Bromley.conditions: No ORV by-law found on the township's by-law page. Listed in O. Reg. 8/03, so ORVs are allowed on municipal roads by default unless prohibited.

Lake of Bays.conditions: By-law 2016-041: ORVs permitted on all municipal highways EXCEPT the roads in Schedule A (the snippet was cut off after 'East Walker Lake Drive'; get the full list from the PDF). Operating conditions are in the by-law.

Tyendinaga.conditions: Only the northern edge is inside the bbox (lat 44.16+). Not researched.

Asphodel-Norwood.conditions: Found incidentally; inside the bbox. By-law 2022-56: ORVs on municipal roads only to link riders to approved trails; not permitted 9:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m.

County of Peterborough (county roads).conditions: ORV By-law 2022-61, Schedule A replaced by 2023-21 / 2023-47 (2023-47a). Only the listed County Road sections are open (e.g. CR 36, 37, 503, 507 in Trent Lakes; CR 6, 30 in HBM). None in North Kawartha. Reviewed every two years. Map: orv_map_oct2023.pdf.

County of Haliburton (county roads).conditions: No county ORV by-law text found. A 2015 local news item said riders could use public road shoulders in Haliburton County from July 1 (2015 provincial change). County By-law 3709 appeared in searches about Schedule A but its contents are unknown. County roads include CR 21, 503, 648, 121 and others.

County of Renfrew (county roads).conditions: By-law 91-24: ORVs may operate on County of Renfrew roads if they meet and are operated per O. Reg. 316/03. Earlier 7-21 (amended 56-23) may have listed designated routes; check whether 91-24 replaced them. Some towns (Petawawa, Arnprior) designate routes only.

County of Lennox and Addington (county r.conditions: County ORV by-law covers County roads in Addington Highlands, Loyalist, Greater Napanee and Stone Mills. Amendment 3326/16 added vehicle types 'on certain County roads'.

County of Hastings (county roads).conditions: No county ORV by-law found. Hastings County may not operate a county road network (roads are lower-tier), but this is unverified. Use the lower-tier rules.

County of Frontenac.conditions: Frontenac County is not known to own roads. The K&P Trail (County) allows ORVs with valid ORV Act permits under By-law 2022-0033; dirt bikes may be restricted (unverified forum claim).

permit_trail_systems.name: EOTA network incl. Hastings Heritage Trail (Glen Ross to Lake St. Peter, ~156 km, via Marmora, Bancroft)
permit_trail_systems.permit: EOTA trail pass ('OnePass'); Destination Ontario lists 'OnePass EOTA, OFATV'
permit_trail_systems.notes: Undated prices: about $150/yr, $75/week, $20/day; check current. Sold at Limerick Lake Lodge and 20+ outlets. EOTA's map has shown some trails its pass does not cover, which need an OFATV pass or no pass. The Park to Park trail joined the EOTA OnePass.

permit_trail_systems.name: Coe Hill Riders ATV Club (Wollaston Rail Trail, Limerick-area trails)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Trail access pass from OFATV, EOTA, KATVA or HATVA (Wollaston By-law 2021-0005); signs say a trail permit is required
permit_trail_systems.notes: Lease of the Wollaston Rail Trail extended to Feb 1, 2029 (2024 draft minutes). Limerick has club agreements (e.g. By-law 2025-04).

permit_trail_systems.name: HATVA - Haliburton ATV Association (1,700+ km) incl. Haliburton County Rail Trail
permit_trail_systems.permit: HATVA pass (KATVA pass also accepted on the Rail Trail)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Rail Trail motorized season May 1 - Nov 30. Lake of Bays ATV Club honours HATVA permits and sells day passes (~$20/day, $30/2 days).

permit_trail_systems.name: KATVA - Kawartha ATV Association (Kawartha Lakes / Victoria Rail Trail area)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Accepted on the Haliburton County Rail Trail.

permit_trail_systems.name: Renfrew County recreational trails (Algonquin Trail / Ottawa Valley Recreational Trail, K&P Trail in Renfrew County)
permit_trail_systems.permit: OFATV permit via getapermit.ofatv.org, choosing Renfrew County ATV Club (RCATV)
permit_trail_systems.notes: County By-law 139-24 (trail use; also 81-24). ATVs allowed May 1 - Nov 30. Older news saying ATVs ride free in Renfrew County is out of date.

permit_trail_systems.name: Haliburton Forest (private)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Haliburton Forest day/season permit (e.g. ~$52/day per driver + HST)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Private trail system, separate from HATVA.

permit_trail_systems.name: OFATV QuadON network (general)
permit_trail_systems.notes: Province-wide club network. Check which club covers which trail.

permit_trail_systems.name: Frontenac K&P Trail (Frontenac County)
permit_trail_systems.permit: Unclear; county by-law requires ORVs to hold valid ORV Act permits (vehicle permit). Whether a trail pass is required is unverified.
